items.title: Birational filtered D-module computation and local vanishing for Hodge ideals of positive rational principal divisors
items.author: Mustaţǎ, Mircea; Popa, Mihnea
items.work: Hodge ideals for Q-divisors: birational approach
items.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 6 (2019), publisher version, DOI10.5802/jep.94
items.difficulty_reason: Equivariant cyclic covers define the filtered rational-power D-module. The twisted logarithmic Spencer complex is proved exact by explicit local normal-form induction; toric normalization then determines the round-up lattice and eigenspace filtration. Strictness yields the birational vanishing and exact filtered image computing every Hodge ideal only after those complete new constructions.
